name: Slow-cooked bolognese (3.5 hours)
title: Slow bolognese

steps.text: Dice the onion, carrots and celery.
Big deep pot: olive oil, the veg and the rosemary, medium heat 5 min.
All the mince in, high heat, brown it; season.
Rosemary out, red wine in, let the alcohol cook off.
Passata in, lowest heat. Stir every 10-15 min from now on.
Stir and check it is not catching.
